_comment: Model rev 3 deep-fold knee variant (user decision 2026-11-03, evidence 191/192): rev3_b.json with the knee four-bar replaced by a knee_fold_study.py pick whose band reaches 2.96 rad, so the legs can tuck under the prone body. Everything else equals rev3_b.json. joint_range widens the MJCF knee stop and the coupled ankle stop to the band (ASSUMED: no shin-thigh or ankle-rod clash checked). Not adopted until the get-up and running checks of evidence 192.

hip_yaw.why: estimated turning load 25 N·m at 8 rad/s (evidence 186); belt 0.10 kg + bracket 0.05 kg

hip_roll.why: peak GRF x 0.10 m; with the 1.5 belt the RMS exceeds the rated torque (x1.43)

hip_pitch.why: speed-up belt: the 11.1 m/s design hip speed 20.6 rad/s fits even at -10 % no-load speed

knee_pitch.why: module on the upper femur, four-bar below (N 0.62-2.15 over the knee band)

fourbar.why: knee_fold_study.py (200000 random four-bars): band 0.706-2.964 rad, worst score 1.21 against 1.05 of the rev3_b pick (policy-load peak utilisation 1.21 vs 0.84, design x1.2 RMS 1.11 vs 0.91); N 0.34 at the deepest fold; coupler 0.321 m is longer than the 0.22 m femur (packaging unchecked)
